title: Rapid 1:1 prep — PM <> Eng Lead (API / Console / Dedicated / Private)
content:
Context / goals
- Quick prep for weekly 1:1 with Eng Lead (Kai). Agenda keeps to 30m.
- Primary goals: unblock Dedicated capacity onboarding, confirm console rollout schedule, align on API throttle experiment and observable requirements for Private deploys.
- Bring 2 asks and 2 decisions; leave time for Kai’s top risks.

Agenda (target: 30 min)
1) 5m - quick sync / personal check-in (any headcount/availability surprises)
2) 8m - Dedicated onboarding status + rollout gating (who needs which tickets cleared)
3) 8m - Console UX rollout: canary metrics + fallback plan for model-config UI
4) 6m - API throttle experiment + perf guardrails; Private deploy observability ask
5) 3m - decisions / clear action owners

Quick bullets to hit in meeting
- Dedicated onboarding: we need infra sign-off on the hardened network template (INFR-824). Engineering says template ready but SRE wants one more integration test on cross-AZ failover. Ask: can we prioritize that test this sprint? If yes, goal: finish by Thu 01/23. Impact: Dedicated early customers (beta) scheduled for 02/05 — risk if failover not validated.
- Console rollout: A/B canary running in us-west1 with 2% traffic. Metrics dashboard currently missing token-level cost slice by model variant. Request: add one more chart (cost by model variant, 24h) to canary dashboard before increasing to 10%. Quick win: use current query in grafana draft /dashboard/d/937-costs -> can wire to canary tag.
- Model-config UI UX regression: product flagged that large model lists cause slow load (>2.5s). Engineering suggests server-side pagination + caching; product concerned about discoverability. Decision needed: server-side pagination now + search box, vs client-side virtualization later. Lean to server-side for perf.
- API throttle experiment: prod traffic shape changed after promo; need a soft throttling policy per-tenant that returns 429 with Retry-After for predictable latency under high QPS. Ask eng to sketch a rollout plan (stages: test in staging -> canary 5% -> global). Also want a canary metric: p95 latency and queue depth.
- Private deploys: request from sales: add lightweight buﬀer metrics surfaced in the private control plane (queue length, avg processing time, last model version). Engineering note: exposing these requires KMS token scope changes for some customers. Need to confirm security review window (estimated 2 weeks).

Notes to self (things Kai might say / follow-ups to take):
- If they push the failover test later, ask for interim mitigation: explicit SLA language for beta customers + runbook for manual failover.
- If SRE blocks the dashboard change, escalate to platform PM (Arjun) and propose a temporary dashboard hosted in product analytics.
- Watch for capacity slack — Dedicated pool sizing might need +1 GPU cluster if we’re increasing Dedicated beta. Budget question (who owns) — maybe finance/ops but bring to next triage.

Open questions (to resolve in meeting or after)
- Can we get the failover integration test scheduled this week (who? — SRE lead)?
- Are we okay with server-side pagination for model list UX now, and roadmap the virtualization later? (tradeoffs: perf now vs extra server work)
- For Private control-plane metrics: which metrics are top-3 that product can show without security changes?
- Throttling semantics: prefer 429 vs graceful queuing (queue might add latency); need convo with SRE on queue depth limits.

Proposed quick decisions I want us to make in 1:1
- Approve server-side pagination + search for model list now (engineering to implement) — owner: Eng (Kai) — target: Feb 2
- Greenlight failover test priority for Dedicated onboarding (if not possible, commit to runbook and customer communication) — owner: SRE + Eng — target: Jan 23
- Approve throttle experiment staging plan (staging -> canary 5%) — owner: Eng/Platform — target: next sprint planning

Action items (explicit)
- A1: Kai to confirm SRE test slot for cross-AZ failover and tag INFR-824 with test ETA — owner: Kai Morgan — due: 2025-01-23
- A2: Renee to prepare customer-facing note for Dedicated beta (status + risk + mitigation) once test ETA known — owner: Renee Alvarez — due: 2025-01-24
- A3: Eng to add cost-by-variant chart to canary dashboard and share link — owner: Arjun Patel (platform analytics) — due: 2025-01-21
- A4: Kai to propose server-side pagination API contract + perf targets (p50 < 200ms for list endpoint) — owner: Kai Morgan — due: 2025-02-02
- A5: Renee + Legal to get list of allowable metrics for Private control plane (to avoid KMS scope changes) — owner: Renee Alvarez / Legal — due: 2025-01-30
- A6: Eng to draft throttle rollout plan (staging -> 5% canary) and list canary metrics (p95 latency, 429 rate, queue depth) — owner: Kai Morgan — due: 2025-01-28

Follow-up template (for after meeting)
- Summary: 2–3 bullet decisions made
- Owners + due dates confirmed
- Slack ping to #platform-infra summarizing decisions and tagging owners
- Update JIRA tickets with notes + link to dashboard/PRs

Random scribbles / quick links to paste in convo:
- Dashboard draft: grafana.redwood/d/937-costs (cost by model variant)
- Failover ticket: JIRA INFR-824 -> mention test-runner logs
- Pagination PR example: github.com/example/virtual-list (link archetype for eng)

Post-meeting quick checklist (my responsibilities)
- Send meeting summary in Slack thread (5–10 mins after)
- Create/update customer beta note (if failover delayed)
- Add new dashboard link to JIRA canary ticket
- Schedule quick follow-up (10 min) if any owner misses ETA

Notes to self: keep this doc short and iterative — will copy into final meeting notes doc after call. If Kai wants deeper dive on capacity math, switch to separate session (30m) and bring capacity model spreadsheet (link in linked_artifacts).

Unresolved / future topics (parked)
- Quantization guidance for Dedicated GPUs (Ops + Research deep dive)
- Long-term model routing policy (cost-first vs latency-first tiers)

End of scratchpad
